recognize_zh: H&E 組織中瀰漫小到中型淋巴球浸潤，核圓至略不規則、部分可見小核仁，細胞間夾雜大量紅血球，呈紅髓式（red pulp）分布型態，符合 T-PLL 侵犯脾臟或組織；確認需 TCL1 與 T 細胞標記。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; some cells with small visible nucleoli
Abundant interspersed erythrocytes suggesting infiltration of blood-rich (red pulp-like) tissue
No nodular or follicular architecture in this field
describe_en: H&E section shows a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, admixed with abundant erythrocytes in a red pulp-like pattern. No follicular or nodular architecture is identified in the field. Findings are consistent with tissue involvement by a small-to-medium T-cell leukemia such as T-prolymphocytic leukemia; immunohistochemistry for CD3, CD4/CD8, CD7 and TCL1 is needed to confirm.

ddx.vs: HSTL shows sinusoidal/red pulp involvement by medium cells but is TCR gamma-delta, CD4/CD8-negative and TCL1-negative, with isochromosome 7q.
HCL infiltrates red pulp with blood lakes and fried-egg cells with abundant clear cytoplasm, and is a CD20+/annexin A1+ B-cell neoplasm.
CLL involves white pulp nodules with proliferation centers and is a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell neoplasm.
